repositories.name: approval-flow-core
repositories.description: A deterministic approval-request core with authorized transitions, expected versions and reconstructable history. It records internal decisions without making payments, sending messages or invoking external systems.

repositories.name: budget-hold-ledger
repositories.description: Go quota ledger with concurrent reservations, explicit dispatch, settlement and uncertain-charge reconciliation. Retains overage evidence and blocks new holds. Includes race tests, bounded audit history and an offline demo.

repositories.name: business-day-calendar
repositories.description: A business-date library with configured weekends and explicit closure dates. It calculates operational dates with LocalDate without inferring legal holidays or replacing employment/contract rules.

repositories.name: cidr-subnet-planner
repositories.description: Offline IPv4/IPv6 CIDR audit and deterministic subnet planning in Python. Finds overlaps and non-canonical prefixes, allocates aligned VLSM blocks around reservations and reports exact free address space.

repositories.name: config-provenance-resolver
repositories.description: A layered configuration resolver producing effective state and per-path write provenance. It never reads the host environment and masks sensitive trace values without correlatable secret hashes.

repositories.name: cursor-page-kit
repositories.description: A forward keyset-pagination core with validated opaque cursors and a PDO/SQLite example. It demonstrates stable snapshot pagination with repeated sort values without building another CRUD dashboard.

repositories.name: deficit-round-queue
repositories.description: A bounded, clock-free Deficit Round Robin scheduler for caller-owned work IDs and integer costs. It exposes complete rounds, cancellation and credit accounting without executing jobs or sending packets.

repositories.name: duplex-drain-pump
repositories.description: A bounded Linux library for relaying two connected stream sockets while preserving backpressure and directional EOF. Includes a socketpair lab for partial writes, half-close draining and explicit idle deadlines.

repositories.name: ets-snapshot-bundles
repositories.description: An ETS-backed immutable bundle index with monitored reader leases and atomic generation publication. Readers can inspect several keys without mixing versions, while pinned generations and request admission remain explicitly bounded.

repositories.name: freebusy-slot-studio
repositories.description: Offline browser studio and Node CLI for common availability. Intersects dated working intervals, subtracts buffered busy blocks and explains conflicts. Uses explicit UTC offsets and bounded slot generation.

repositories.name: fulfillment-reconciliation-lab
repositories.description: A synthetic integration and reconciliation lab correlating orders, reservation events and shipment snapshots, explaining quantity mismatches and missing evidence without money, payments or live inventory operations.

repositories.name: github-evidence-board
repositories.description: Static browser workbench and Node CLI for inspecting public GitHub evidence snapshots, source SHAs, CI results and snapshot age. Includes synthetic offline demos, local import/export and explicit public API refresh.

repositories.name: guillotine-cut-plan
repositories.description: A deterministic rectangle-packing library producing replayable guillotine cut certificates with integer dimensions, kerf and per-item rotation rules. Intended for planning experiments, not machine control or optimality claims.

repositories.name: har-budget-audit
repositories.description: A local HAR analyzer summarizing requests, known response bytes and latency percentiles by origin against explicit budgets. It does not capture traffic or invent performance scores.

repositories.name: health-probe-cli
repositories.description: A one-shot HTTP probe for teams that need expected-status, availability, latency and response-limit checks in a JSON report. It is not a continuous monitoring service.

repositories.name: http-freshness-core
repositories.description: A pure calculator of HTTP response age and a restricted freshness verdict from structured metadata and explicit times. It neither stores responses nor parses raw headers or implements a complete cache/proxy.

repositories.name: metric-cardinality-audit
repositories.description: An offline cardinality auditor for an explicit Prometheus text-format subset. It counts series and distinct label values without reproducing label values in reports.

repositories.name: mqtt-session-recovery-lab
repositories.description: An end-to-end loopback Mosquitto lab for MQTT 3.1.1 retained messages, persistent sessions, queued QoS 1 delivery and Last Will. Fixed scenarios assert protocol outcomes without cloud brokers, credentials or a browser.

repositories.name: ndjson-redact
repositories.description: An NDJSON log transformer that replaces explicitly selected JSON Pointer fields with per-record processing, explicit limits and diagnostics that do not repeat values. It does not promise complete anonymization.

repositories.name: openapi-example-check
repositories.description: An offline checker of JSON request/response body examples against a documented OpenAPI 3.1.1 subset. It helps API authors keep examples consistent without calling the real service.

repositories.name: positional-record-codec
repositories.description: PHP codec for explicit fixed-width record layouts. Parses and formats header/detail/trailer batches with exact minor-unit control sums, bounded input and diagnostics without raw field values. Includes synthetic offline fixtures.

repositories.name: posix-run-capture
repositories.description: A local Linux runner that captures stdout/stderr from an explicitly supplied command with output bounds, a deadline and a structured result. It is an automation utility, not a sandbox or agent orchestrator.

repositories.name: resumable-transfer-lab
repositories.description: A .NET utility and end-to-end lab for interrupted local HTTP transfers using persisted state, Range/If-Range, a strong ETag and caller-supplied digest, without claiming production transport or origin authenticity.

repositories.name: retrieval-eval-kit
repositories.description: An offline evaluator of retrieval rankings using Recall@K, MRR@K, source hit rate and abstention decisions on labeled cases. It calls no models and does not assess the semantic truth of generated answers.

repositories.name: rollout-rule-engine
repositories.description: Ruby feature-flag evaluation core with typed targeting rules, prerequisite cycle detection, complete SemVer comparisons and reproducible SHA-256 cohort buckets. Includes bounded decision traces and synthetic offline demos.

repositories.name: saga-compensation-lab
repositories.description: A Java integration lab for sequential compensable steps against local HTTP services, demonstrating reverse-order compensation and recovery from lost acknowledgments while blocking unresolved outcomes.

repositories.name: schema-form-studio
repositories.description: Offline browser studio and Node CLI for a bounded JSON Schema subset. Builds labeled forms, validates instances and exports JSON. Includes explicit unsupported-keyword errors and a finite-state pattern matcher.

repositories.name: sequence-gap-audit
repositories.description: A sequential-event log auditor identifying final gaps, repeated sequence numbers and out-of-order arrivals per stream. It is offline integrity inspection, not a broker consumer or event executor.

repositories.name: spill-outer-join
repositories.description: A bounded external-sort full outer join for local keyed JSONL streams. It preserves duplicate multiplicity, exposes SQL-like null nonmatching and publishes no result when parsing, Cartesian expansion or disk limits fail.

repositories.name: sqlite-migration-rehearsal-lab
repositories.description: A disposable SQLite migration rehearsal using a consistent copy, explicit invariants and up/down/up state comparisons, preserving the source and avoiding general SQL-equivalence claims.

repositories.name: sse-stream-inspector
repositories.description: Incremental offline SSE capture inspector in Rust. Handles arbitrary chunk boundaries, event framing, IDs and retry fields, with strict UTF-8 diagnostics and independent retention limits. Includes JSON/text reports and CLI demo.

repositories.name: static-link-audit
repositories.description: An offline auditor of link targets and fragments in a local HTML export. It helps teams check sites before handoff without an external crawler or claims of complete SEO/security auditing.

repositories.name: tenant-policy-lab
repositories.description: A reproducible PostgreSQL lab demonstrating tenant access policies with separate roles, synthetic data and negative read/write tests. It is a bounded RLS example, not a general SaaS security guarantee.

repositories.name: test-shard-plan
repositories.description: A deterministic test-to-worker partition planner using supplied durations and affinity groups. It fills the execution-balancing gap without calculating dependencies or running tests.

repositories.name: trace-waterfall-svg
repositories.description: An offline converter of complete trace events into a standalone SVG with process/thread tracks and an explicit time scale. It helps inspect concurrent operations without uploading traces to a service.

repositories.name: transactional-outbox-lab
repositories.description: Python/SQLite transactional outbox lab with atomic domain/event writes, fenced worker leases, retry scheduling and dead letters. Demonstrates at-least-once delivery and consumer deduplication with reproducible offline fault injection.

repositories.name: utc-cron-preview
repositories.description: A deterministic preview of future occurrences for an explicit five-field UTC cron subset. It helps review automations before configuration without installing jobs or executing commands.

repositories.name: webhook-signature-lab
repositories.description: An offline library and lab for signing and verifying raw webhook bodies with an explicit HMAC protocol and caller-supplied time. It complements idempotency controls without executing events or claiming provider compatibility.

repositories.name: window-stats-stream
repositories.description: A Java 21 library and CLI for deterministic computation of numerical statistics over tumbling and sliding time windows on event streams. It uses explicit event timestamps, watermark progression to classify late arrivals, Welford's online al
